Summary
Create guided flows to help artists claim Spotify for Artists and Apple Music for Artists:
- Pre-fill forms or assemble required assets (photos, bio, links)
- Provide step-by-step instructions and checklists
- Save state and follow-up reminders

Acceptance criteria
- A checklist UI that lists platform steps, required assets, and deep links.
- "Copy package" feature that bundles suggested bio, artist photo, and contact email for quick paste into claim forms.
- Analytics: track completion progress.

Tasks
- Design simple checklist templates for Spotify & Apple.
- Add "prepare claim package" export that compiles images + text into a zip for the user.
- Add in-app help modal with links to official claim pages.

Tech notes
- Avoid automating account creation; only assist with instructions and asset prep.
